iso_junctions.note: Union of per-échangeur drive-time polygons; signal #1 fires when the parcel centroid falls inside any of them.

iso_core.note: The metro's last-mile band; signal #3 fires inside any core isochrone.

pop.source: INSEE Filosofi carreaux 200 m via Géoplateforme WFS
pop.note: Cell centroids with resident counts (ind). Signal #2 sums population within a radius of the parcel centroid. Residents, not consumption spend; an honest proxy.

grid.source: Enedis, Postes électriques (postes HTA/BT), Licence Ouverte 2.0
grid.note: Position of every HTA/BT substation inside the métropole bbox, [lon,lat]. POSITIONS ONLY. Enedis publishes no spare-capacity figure on any of its 266 datasets, so distance to a substation says a connection point is near and says NOTHING about whether it has room. The site's own subscribed power in kVA is a contract and has to be asked for. Refreshed by Enedis twice a year.
